title: documentation: webpage performance
body:
After we release 1.0.0, we can optimize again the documentation (by order of importance):

* \[ ] use an svg sprite (can be generated on https://icomoon.io/) =>  -- requests for small things
  There are also gulp/grunt tasks to automate this I believe. Like https://github.com/jkphl/svg-sprite
* \[x] use minified versions for JS and CSS (currently using unminified main.css, home.js, default-theme.css)
* \[x] combine jquery plugins from jsdelivr in a single jsdelivr tag => -- requests for small things
* \[ ] optimize svg sprite in the build step (svgo sprite.png)
* \[ ] optimize remaining img on build
* \[ ] minify html
  Any other idea, add it here
